text:
ashwin: Quick ask — product wants tenant-level SLO notify "quiet" overrides in Console (preview/soft/force). Need design, telemetry, and safety rollback ideas.

tess: Preview-first UX is key. Show estimated alerts/day and cost delta, with a risk meter. Preview mode should be default.

maria: Telemetry: emit `slo.notify.expected` and `slo.notify.actual` with `override_id` tag. Also sample pre/post request/response pairs (configurable, default 0.1%).

keith: Ops notes: overrides must be auditable and immutable. Log events: `override.create`, `override.apply`, `override.rollback` with actor. Keep traces 14 days.

samir: Backend sketch: enforcement hook checks override; for `soft` reduce fanout multiplier (e.g., 0.5) and lower notify threshold; for `force` route to specified variant. Record `slo.override.applied`.

ashwin: Safety: automatic rollback rule if `slo.quality.delta > 0.03` for 30m post-apply — revert and page. Also add console banner for overrides older than 30d.

tess: Rollout: internal + 10 alpha tenants, plus a 2k-tenant preview-only canary to validate estimates.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created task PLAT-6110 and scheduled staging canary 2024-07-20 (job: canary-330).

ashwin: I'll draft RFC with API proto, telemetry table, and console mocks. Followups: sampling limits per-org, audit SSO actor mapping, runbook rollback snippet.
